And the Cursor obligation is worse than the fixed-consideration reading carried since June: merger terms make the consideration VWAP-BASED (Class A shares issued per $60B implied value at SPCX's 7-day VWAP immediately before closing, expected Q3 2026), so each leg down mechanically increases the shares to be issued — dilution that scales with weakness, the signature of a stock-settled obligation under strain. Termination exposure is also now quantified: $10B if the deal collapses under specified conditions, $4B if antitrust-blocked. Margin/pledge trigger levels remain unquantified (null), so RED-type forced events cannot be ruled in or out from public data; none is visible.
